messages:
maria_p: Quick sync — drafting the internal RN + announce we send to staff before tonight's deploy (v1.29.0). Need 2 things: 1) final microcopy for the internal blurb, 2) who will pin + run deploybot for the canary. Deploy window: 02:00–04:00 UTC.

sachin: Short blurb suggestion — 'v1.29.0: runtime perf + cost optimizations. Includes KV-cache hotfix, quantization profile updates for Llama-compat models, and a safety patch for rate-limit edge cases. Canary -> EU -> global. Rollback on error-rate spike >1.5% or latency regression >200ms P95.'

lisa: +1 on sachin's text. Can we call out the customer-impacting thing in one line? maybe: 'Reduces token-serving cost for streaming jobs by ~30% for typical RLHF workloads.'

maria_p: Good call. New draft: 'v1.29.0 — runtime perf & cost: KV-cache hotfix, improved quant profiles (Llama family), and a rate-limit edge-case safety patch. Expected: ~30% token-cost reduction for streaming RLHF workloads. Canary in EU, then global. Rollback if error rate increases >1.5% or P95 latency regresses by >200ms.'

jordan: I'll run the canary and own rollback. Plan: deploybot --canary region=eu version=v1.29.0, observe 30m, then promote. If we see >1.5% err or >200ms P95 for 3 consecutive 5m windows -> rollback to v1.28.4 and invalidate KV-cache on canary nodes.

ops-oncall: I'll be oncall for the window. Please ping @ops-oncall at deploy start. I'll have shortcuts ready for rollback (rollback script + traffic-split).

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: run_id=DB-20260321-7, user=jordan, target=canary.eu, version=v1.29.0. Reply "confirm" to execute. Logs to: https://internal.builds/reports/DB-20260321-7

jordan: confirm

deploy-bot: deploy started: run_id=DB-20260321-7. Step 1: provision canary pool. Step 2: apply model bundle v1.29.0. Streaming endpoints will warm KV caches. ETA ~6m.

maria_p: Thread for the internal announcement: paste below into #staff-announce after canary looks good. Short header + bullet 2 lines.

maria_p (draft to paste):
> Heads up — we're rolling out v1.29.0 tonight (02:00–04:00 UTC). This release brings runtime perf and cost improvements (KV-cache fixes + updated quant profiles), expected ~30% token-cost reduction for streaming RLHF workloads. Canary in EU, then global. See internal change log: https://internal.docs/release/v1.29.0. Ops will monitor; rollback criteria: >1.5% error-rate increase or P95 latency regression >200ms.

sachin: tiny nit: change 'token-cost' -> 'per-token cost' and add 'ETA for global promotion: ~45–90m after canary'

maria_p: Updated paste:
> Heads up — we're rolling out v1.29.0 tonight (02:00–04:00 UTC). This release brings runtime perf and cost improvements (KV-cache fixes + updated quant profiles), expected ~30% per-token cost reduction for streaming RLHF workloads. Canary in EU; if stable, global promotion expected ~45–90m after canary. See internal change log: https://internal.docs/release/v1.29.0. Ops will monitor; rollback criteria: >1.5% error-rate increase or P95 latency regression >200ms.

lisa: LGTM. Who pins the staff announce once we promote?

jordan: I'll pin after promote + post final note in #staff-announce with link to the RN and canary metrics snapshot.

ops-oncall: Also create a short 'what changed for SRE' snippet in the RN: list the hotfix steps to evict cache, where the quant profiles live, and the temp metric to watch (model_serving:error_rate, model_serving:latency_p95).

maria_p: Good call — I'll add that to the RN now. Final ask: rename the release artifact to include commit sha prefix so rollbacks are exact (e.g., v1.29.0+sha1). Can someone confirm CI will produce that?

deploy-bot: artifact tagging enabled. Will publish artifact as v1.29.0+{short_sha} during build step.

sachin: CI confirmed. Also adding a short deploy checklist: (1) pre-deploy smoke test (2) deploy canary EU (3) 30m observation (4) promote or rollback (5) pin + postmortem if rollback required.

maria_p: Perfect. Thanks all. I'll post the staff announce after jordan gives the green. If rollback happens, jordan + ops-oncall will coordinate and I'll send a short update. :thumbsup:

jordan: Canary up, warming. Will report 30m snapshot.

deploy-bot: canary completed step: provision -> success. bundle apply -> success. warming -> started. Monitoring hooks enabled.

jordan: 30m snapshot: error_rate delta +0.12% (baseline 0.4% -> 0.52%), P95 latency delta +38ms. No customer-facing alerts. Promoting to global in 5.

maria_p: posting staff announce now and pinning after promote. final RN link: https://internal.docs/release/v1.29.0#notes

deploy-bot: promotion started: run_id=DB-20260321-7 -> global.

jordan: promoted. Pinning done. Posted metrics: https://internal.metrics/snapshots/DB-20260321-7

maria_p: Thanks team. I'll save the post-deploy checklist into release page and open a tiny follow-up to capture the quant profile numbers.

ops-oncall: Marking incident-free for this window unless anyone files.

sachin: nice one everyone :party_parrot:
